78308.subject: OpenAI stopped charging for tokens
78308.body:
The Atlas

Автор: GenAI Works


Автор: GenAI Works

    
    
    Прочитайте цю статтю на LinkedIn, щоб приєднатися до обговорення
Прочитати на LinkedIn
https://www.linkedin.com/comm/pulse/openai-stopped-charging-tokens-genai-works-fap2f?lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Aemail_email_series_follow_newsletter_02%3B8APuWjmJTCm2EiAsIXxkIQ%3D%3D&midToken=AQFTjFOONAfT2w&midSig=0o6cAw4-pgMIo1&trk=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_&trkEmail=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_-null-fz96fz~mthaux9l~s5-null-null&eid=fz96fz-mthaux9l-s5
  
Welcome back! Today: failure becoming free, a 25% increase that leaves you with less, 707 GB of robot mistakes and the case for never using one model twice. In today's Atlas Newsletter: What if failure were free? OpenAI is offering big customers outcome pricing, where a solved ticket costs money and a failed one costs nothing. Is a 25% increase always an increase? Anthropic raised Claude Code limits permanently and cut them 17% against what you have today, then conceded it after community fact-checkers ran the numbers. Why publish the runs that went wrong? NVIDIA released 707 GB of real robot data, including 14,268 failure episodes most datasets throw away. Which model should handle this request? LLMRouter picks one per query across 16 routing approaches, so simple questions stop costing frontier prices. PS: Want to collaborate with the biggest GTM engine and distribution moat for AI companies? You can feature your tool with us and reach millions. OpenAI's favorite customers stop paying for tokens Stop paying for usage. Pay only when the AI completes the job. Today you pay for every token whether the answer helped or not.  A failed support ticket costs the same as a solved one. Under outcome pricing, a solved ticket has a price and a failed one is free, which moves the risk onto OpenAI. It isn't alone: → Intercom charges 99 cents per resolved ticket → HubSpot moved to 50 cents per resolved conversation this spring → Sierra and Fin both bill after task completion Cognition has gone further, pledging up to $10 million in credits if it fails to deliver engineering outcomes worth what enterprise clients paid. Salesforce is pushing the idea hardest. Marc Benioff told investors last week that Agentforce customers can now sign contracts tied to revenue growth from AI-assisted sales or savings from automated service.  His framing goes past task metering: charge $2 because we helped you earn $20. The reason this is happening is structural. Salesforce invented per-seat subscription pricing 25 years ago, and per-seat only works when people use the seats.  As agents handle the work, humans stop opening the app, and the meter stops making sense. The catch is attribution.  Stripe has already published guidance warning that sales conversions and business outcomes may come from product changes, marketing or seasonality rather than software, and that without clear attribution

78307.subject: HIP-4 Opens Up

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/eaa70932-7ce4-467e-b338-a662ed575d6a/0xR_NL_Banner_Heading_Wordmark.jpg?t=1776775276)
Caption: 

———————————————————————————

Happy Monday! Kevin Warsh’s hawkish Jackson Hole speech pushed rate hike odds to 60% and sent equities and gold lower. BTC still finished the week 0.9% higher, while a burst of speculation on Robinhood Chain drove UNI and the DEX sector sharply higher. 

We then look at Hyperliquid’s decision to open HIP-4 outcome markets to outside builders. Outcome and Skew have each posted a $40M HYPE bond, but incentives have given Outcome a clear early lead. 

———————————————————————————

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/42e942ec-f31d-4957-8722-a3ac7b121e1e/0xR_NL_Market_Update.png?t=1767631151) [Market Update]
Caption: 

Over the last week, BTC was the only benchmark to finish in the green, gaining a modest 0.9%. The S&P 500 fell 0.1%, the Nasdaq 100 declined 0.4% and gold was the weakest performer at -3.7%. Much of the selling came on Friday following Kevin Warsh’s speech at Jackson Hole.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/80b67d2a-07b0-4d77-ae2f-3d42b42053ee/image.png?t=1788170899)
Caption: 

Warsh’s hawkish tone caught the market off guard. He [pointed](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/31/jackson-hole-fed-chair-kevin-warsh-hawkish-rate-hikes-analysts.html) to the continued resilience of the US economy and warned that policy may need to respond if disinflation does not progress quickly enough. The odds of a September rate hike have since [risen](https://www.investing.com/central-banks/fed-rate-monitor) from 37% a week ago to 60% today. This repricing weighed on equities and rate-sensitive gold, while BTC gave back part of its earlier gains but still ended the week higher.

Within crypto, DEXs were the strongest sector, gaining 11.4%. The move was led by UNI, which rose 12.8% and accounts for 63% of the index.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/ccbe81c1-3aa1-41f4-b52d-56284e2ff7d4/image.png?t=1788170899)
Caption: 

UNI’s rally followed a sharp increase in volumes on Robinhood Chain, driven by meme tokens paired with tokenized equities. Average daily volumes rose close to 150% over the week, with Robinhood Chain accounting for 40% of Uniswap’s total volume on Aug. 29.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/e2a2a919-f150-4776-aeda-b7fe91aadb17/image.png?t=1788170899)
Caption:

Around $6 million was bridged to Ethereum, but most funds remain frozen on-chain, and Crypto.com says its exchange and app were unaffected.
